chunks: Abu Sulayman Ahmad ibn Hawtha al-Bahili narrated, saying: Ibrahim ibn Ishaq an-Nahawandi narrated to us, saying: Abdullah ibn Hammad al-Ansari narrated from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said: The Qa'im will rise on the day of Ashura.

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdullah, referring to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him).
key_terms.الْقَائِمُ: The Qa'im (The Riser), a title for the Awaited Imam Muhammad ibn al-Hasan.
key_terms.يَوْمَ عَاشُورَاءَ: The day of Ashura, the 10th of Muharram.

ai.seo_question: When will Al-Qa'im rise according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) specifically identifies the day of Ashura (10th of Muharram) as the auspicious date for the rise of Al-Qa'im, linking the Mahdi's emergence to the historical triumph of Imam Husayn (AS). In Shia eschatology, this timing signifies the culmination of the Husayni revolution, transforming the day of mourning into a day of global victory and justice. The specificity of the date serves as a key criterion for distinguishing the true Mahdi from pretenders who may claim authority at other times.
